gloss: purchase (of used goods from a seller); buyback; trade-in

definitions.gloss: purchase (of used goods from a seller); buyback; trade-in
definitions.explanation: The act of buying something outright, especially used goods, from a seller. Commonly seen at secondhand shops, pawn shops, and online resale services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古本|ふるほん}→古本：14745_furuhon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買取|かいとり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買取|かいとり}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This shop offers high trade-in prices for used games.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買取|かいとり}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{機種|きしゅ}→機種：13211_kishu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えた→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I used a smartphone trade-in service to switch to a new model.

notes:
USAGE:
{買取|かいとり} refers specifically to the outright purchase of goods (as opposed to consignment or rental). It is extremely common in the secondhand goods market in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買取|かいとり}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (buyback price, trade-in value)
- {買取|かいとり}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (trade-in service)
- {買取|かいとり}⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧ (buyback specialty shop)
- ⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧{買取|かいとり} (high-price purchase — common advertising phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{買取|かいとり} focuses on the buyer's side of purchasing used goods outright. Compare with ⟦{下取|したど}り→下取り：16386_shitadori⟧, which specifically means trading in an old item when purchasing a new one.
